domains.notes: GregTech worldgen exported through the NEI ore plugin helpers bundled in GT5-Unofficial. A vein's weight is its relative pick weight among the veins that can generate in a dimension; dimChances are the plugin's computed per-dimension probabilities keyed by dimension abbreviation. Density and size describe how the picked vein fills chunks. Small ores generate independently at amountPerChunk tries per chunk, and undergroundFluids list per-dimension chunk deposits.
